context: Final governance closure after live recovery of NL/EN route authority and exact production deployment.
root_cause: The live recovery state had been proven in production, but terminal governance was still distributed across runtime evidence and prior chat/agent execution rather than being fully projected into one repository-native closure lineage with skills, AGENTS/chat contract, continuity policy, Brain learning, ledger, human documentation and System Map read-after-write.

evidence.human_system_map: Notion Powerhouse Canonical System Map & Agent Update Contract updated with Live Assurance governance closure
evidence.truth_boundary: Exact ready production proves deployment identity only; functional sub-capabilities require their own current readback.

lessons: A ready exact production deploy is deployment evidence, not blanket functional evidence for every sub-flow.
Live recovery is not fully governed until skills, agent/chat contracts, Brain learning, ledger/docs and System Map all contain the same truth-boundary and are read back.
Historical LIVE/GREEN may never be reused as current health without fresh runtime/provider readback.
prevention: Write terminal production identity into canonical learning and ledger after material live recovery.
Project the same rule into Green Assurance, continuity and AGENTS/chat contract.
Keep functional sub-gates such as pricing and NL↔EN independent from deploy-state truth.
truth_boundary: This record proves governance writeback and exact deployment identity; it does not assert future runtime health without fresh readback.
